literal: Agreement those-without life hut inside snake-with together having-dwelt like-that.
translation: The life of those who live with people lacking inner harmony is like dwelling together with a snake inside a small hut.
modern: மனப்பொருத்தம் இல்லாதவர்களுடன் சேர்ந்து வாழும் வாழ்க்கை, ஒரு சிறிய குடிசைக்குள் பாம்போடு சேர்ந்து வாழ்வதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet vividly illustrates the danger of internal enmity. The word 'உடம்பாடு' refers to mutual agreement or harmony of minds. Living with people who lack this harmony is compared to sharing a 'குடங்கர்' (a small hut) with a venomous snake. Just as one can never sleep peacefully or feel safe in a confined space with a snake, one can never be secure living with those who harbor secret hostility.
